"""Error-path tests for compile and stream."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

SUB = "/app/submission/main.py"
PY = sys.executable

fails = []


def check(name, cond, extra=""):
    if not cond:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL:", name, extra)


def compile_cfg(cfg_bytes):
    p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=cfg_bytes,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()


def stream(path, reqs_bytes):
    p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=reqs_bytes,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()


GOOD = {
    "version": 1, "idle_timeout": 10, "packet_limit": 5, "prefix_width": 2,
    "rules": [{"id": 7, "class": 2, "priority": 10, "ranges": [[100, 105], [-60, -60]]}],
    "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 8}, "gt": {"class": 9}},
}

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
prog_path = os.path.join(tmp, "program.json")
rc, out, err = compile_cfg(json.dumps(GOOD).encode())
check("compile good", rc == 0, out + err)
with open(prog_path, "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(out.encode())

# ---- invalid configs -------------------------------------------------------
bad_configs = {
    "not json": b"{",
    "not object": b"[]",
    "missing key": json.dumps({k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "rules"}).encode(),
    "extra key": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, extra=1)).encode(),
    "bad version": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, version=2)).encode(),
    "bool version": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, version=True)).encode(),
    "float timeout": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, idle_timeout=1.5)).encode(),
    "neg timeout": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, idle_timeout=-1)).encode(),
    "big timeout": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, idle_timeout=10**9 + 1)).encode(),
    "zero limit": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, packet_limit=0)).encode(),
    "big limit": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, packet_limit=10**9 + 1)).encode(),
    "zero width": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, prefix_width=0)).encode(),
    "big width": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, prefix_width=33)).encode(),
    "rules not list": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules={})).encode(),
    "rule missing key": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3}])).encode(),
    "rule extra key": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]], "x": 1}])).encode(),
    "dup id": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[
        {"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]]},
        {"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]]}])).encode(),
    "neg id": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": -1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]]}])).encode(),
    "huge id": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 2**31, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]]}])).encode(),
    "class too big": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 65536, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]]}])).encode(),
    "empty ranges": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": []}])).encode(),
    "too many ranges": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1]] * 33}])).encode(),
    "range reversed": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[5, 1]]}])).encode(),
    "range too big": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 2049]]}])).encode(),
    "range too small": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[-2049, 0]]}])).encode(),
    "range len 1": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0]]}])).encode(),
    "range len 3": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0, 1, 2]]}])).encode(),
    "range not list": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [0]}])).encode(),
    "range float": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[{"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 3, "ranges": [[0.0, 1]]}])).encode(),
    "fallback leaf extra": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback={"class": 3, "x": 1})).encode(),
    "fallback bad feature": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback={"feature": 2, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}})).encode(),
    "fallback neg feature": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback={"feature": -1, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}})).encode(),
    "fallback bad threshold": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback={"feature": 0, "threshold": 2049, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}})).encode(),
    "fallback missing gt": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback={"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}})).encode(),
    "fallback not dict": json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback=5)).encode(),
    "duplicate json key": b'{"version":1,"version":1}',
    "nan": b'{"version":NaN}',
    "infinity": b'{"version":Infinity}',
}
for name, blob in bad_configs.items():
    rc, out, err = compile_cfg(blob)
    check("bad config " + name, rc == 2 and out.strip() == '{"error":"config"}', (rc, out, err))

# deep tree (>16 edges)
node = {"class": 1}
for _ in range(20):
    node = {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": node}
rc, out, err = compile_cfg(json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback=node)).encode())
check("bad config deep tree", rc == 2 and out.strip() == '{"error":"config"}', (rc, out))

# tree with exactly 16 edges is fine
node = {"class": 1}
for _ in range(16):
    node = {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": node}
rc, out, err = compile_cfg(json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback=node)).encode())
check("good config 16 edge tree", rc == 0, (rc, out, err))

# too many tree nodes (>255)
def wide(depth):
    if depth == 0:
        return {"class": 1}
    return {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": wide(depth - 1), "gt": wide(depth - 1)}
rc, out, err = compile_cfg(json.dumps(dict(GOOD, fallback=wide(7))).encode())
check("bad config too many tree nodes", rc == 2 and out.strip() == '{"error":"config"}', (rc, out))

# empty rules is legal
rc, out, err = compile_cfg(json.dumps(dict(GOOD, rules=[])).encode())
check("good config empty rules", rc == 0, (rc, out, err))

# ---- stream errors --------------------------------------------------------
def expect_event_error(name, reqs, prefix_ok=True):
    rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, reqs)
    lines = out.splitlines()
    ok = rc == 2 and lines and json.loads(lines[-1]) == {"error": "event"}
    check("stream error " + name, ok, (rc, out, err))
    if prefix_ok and len(lines) > 1:
        for line in lines[:-1]:
            check("stream error " + name + " prior response", "error" not in line, line)


expect_event_error("malformed json", b"{not json}\n")
expect_event_error("blank line", b"\n")
expect_event_error("whitespace line", b"   \n")
expect_event_error("not object", b"[]\n")
expect_event_error("unknown op", b'{"op":"bogus"}\n')
expect_event_error("missing key", b'{"op":"open","flow":1}\n')
expect_event_error("extra key", b'{"op":"tick","time":1,"x":2}\n')
expect_event_error("bad flow type", b'{"op":"open","flow":"1","time":0}\n')
expect_event_error("bool flow", b'{"op":"open","flow":true,"time":0}\n')
expect_event_error("float time", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1.5}\n')
expect_event_error("neg flow", b'{"op":"open","flow":-1,"time":0}\n')
expect_event_error("huge flow", b'{"op":"open","flow":2147483648,"time":0}\n')
expect_event_error("huge time", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":9007199254740992}\n')
expect_event_error("duplicate open", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1}\n')
expect_event_error("decreasing time", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5}\n{"op":"tick","time":4}\n')
expect_event_error("decreasing time chunk", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5}\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":6,"source":0,"length":5},{"flow":1,"time":3,"source":0,"length":5}]}\n')
expect_event_error("absent flow packet", b'{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":9,"time":1,"source":0,"length":5}]}\n')
expect_event_error("absent flow close", b'{"op":"close","flow":9,"time":1}\n')
expect_event_error("restore not first", b'{"op":"tick","time":1}\n{"op":"restore","checkpoint":{}}\n')
expect_event_error("restore bad value", b'{"op":"restore","checkpoint":5}\n')
expect_event_error("packet bad length", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":0}]}\n')
expect_event_error("packet bad length high", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":2049}]}\n')
expect_event_error("packet bad source", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":2,"length":5}]}\n')
expect_event_error("packet extra key", b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":5,"z":0}]}\n')
expect_event_error("packets not list", b'{"op":"chunk","packets":{}}\n')
expect_event_error("checkpoint extra key", b'{"op":"checkpoint","x":1}\n')

# partial events must not be emitted for a failing chunk
rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":102},{"flow":2,"time":2,"source":0,"length":5}]}\n')
lines = out.splitlines()
check("partial chunk no events", len(lines) == 2 and json.loads(lines[-1]) == {"error": "event"}, out)

# too many live flows
reqs = []
for i in range(4097):
    reqs.append(json.dumps({"op": "open", "flow": i, "time": i}))
rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, ("\n".join(reqs) + "\n").encode())
lines = out.splitlines()
check("4096 flows ok, 4097 fails", rc == 2 and len(lines) == 4097 and json.loads(lines[-1]) == {"error": "event"}, (rc, len(lines)))

# 4096 flows fine
reqs = [json.dumps({"op": "open", "flow": i, "time": i}) for i in range(4096)]
rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, ("\n".join(reqs) + "\n").encode())
check("4096 flows accepted", rc == 0, (rc, out[-200:], err[-500:]))

# checkpoint response shape
rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\n{"op":"checkpoint"}\n')
lines = out.splitlines()
check("checkpoint shape", rc == 0 and json.loads(lines[1]) and set(json.loads(lines[1])) == {"checkpoint"}, out)

# EOF without newline still processed
rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, b'{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}')
check("no trailing newline", rc == 0 and len(out.splitlines()) == 1, (rc, out))

# empty stream
rc, out, err = stream(prog_path, b"")
check("empty stream", rc == 0 and out == "", (rc, out))

print("failures:", len(fails))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
